prompt: A cluster of giant crystal formations growing from a flat round slab of cavern rock: tall clean hexagonal crystal prisms with sharp pointed faceted tips, of very different heights, the tallest in the centre, the others leaning outward around it in a crown. In front of the crystals stands a small relay mast with a boxy housing and three crossbars; at one side stands a mine lift headframe: a steel lattice tower with a big winding wheel at the top and a lift cage. Clean sharp faceted geometry, mining-world sci-fi. Isolated 3D model render on a plain uniform medium-grey studio background, the whole object fully in frame with generous margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no lettering, no logos, no people. Crisp hard-surface modelling with bold, clearly separated parts and a strong readable silhouette: chunky forms and clean edges, no clutter, no hanging moss, no dangling wires.
